notes.manas-2010:p1590:b001:l010: Burchak is the printed short form following Muzburchak; retained rather than harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1590:b001:l016: Жайсаң rendered officers: edition glossary p1837:27–28 identifies a lesser commander/companion rank. The epithet Kalcha elsewhere is grim-faced, following Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/калча/.
notes.manas-2010:p1590:b001:l024: Compressed 23–24 names Kongurbay then Ay Jangjung; English takes both as advancing from the flank. Their exact coordination is provisional; neither name omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1590:b001:l032: Zhoykuma retained as the sword name, not a club: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жой/ and Manas encyclopedia https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lang=en&lfrom=kg&word=АЛТЫ+КУРЧ identify the weapon. Distinguish descriptive ойкума at1603:28.
notes.manas-2010:p1591:b001:l012: Swift runners and One-Eyes retain the epic troop descriptions; no claim that ordinary Chinese people possess one eye.
notes.manas-2010:p1591:b001:l020: Сайса is spear thrusting, not proof that each thrust penetrates armor. The repeated immobility of bodies and buttocks in22–24 is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1592:b001:l007: Сан is an epic multitude unit, rendered vast host without assigning an invented census. Same treatment1593:34 and1597:2; explicit seven retained for түмөн1600:28.
notes.manas-2010:p1592:b001:l008: Чалды-куйду = tangled/chaotic, confirmed Yudakhin and1969 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/чалды/.
notes.manas-2010:p1592:b001:l035: Printed Ал жабышып какчайып retained. Clinging close/stiff is a qualified literal bodily reading in the riding context; no silent emendation of Ал or the verb.
notes.manas-2010:p1593:b001:l001: Printed туштап, not муштап. Squarely is a qualified reading of alignment/meeting in the blow-to-ribs context; no transcription emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1593:b001:l009: Түп этектен: coat hem is a qualified concrete reading of этек while seizing the fallen opponent; exact grasp is not independently established.
notes.manas-2010:p1593:b001:l012: The narrator explicitly asks whether the horse has wings in12–13; preserved as a question, not converted to a flat assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1593:b001:l037: Printed plural аттарын retained even though the next display line names Almambet alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1594:b001:l005: Accusative Бээжинди leads a compressed clause across5–11. English preserves Beijing/Kakan-Chin and the rapid-action phrase rather than repairing source syntax; twelve days in12 is retained despite the apparent rapid arrival.
notes.manas-2010:p1594:b001:l020: Ашык-анык: thoroughly is a qualified contextual intensifier for the eloquent envoy, based on ашык excess and анык definite/clear. Exact compound was not found in the consulted ашык entry; not confidently treated as a separate proper name. The envoy is named Changtiybes in25.
notes.manas-2010:p1594:b001:l030: Сурак алуу here means acquiring rule/authority, not interrogation: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/сурак/.
notes.manas-2010:p1594:b001:l033: Агача describes a fair young wife https://el-sozduk.kg/агача/; үптө in34 concerns managing all the spoils https://el-sozduk.kg/үптө/. The women explicitly appear as proposed booty; preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1595:b001:l001: Мыйзамдын гүлү = autumn gossamer, Yudakhin мыйзам sense6 https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/. Not flower of a law.
notes.manas-2010:p1595:b001:l025: Чатыраш = chess in Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/чатыраш/. The2015 account also describes a traditional fourteen-piece variant; no modern rules inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1595:b001:l026: Кутурмач ойно is the wild/out-of-mind playing idiom, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кутурмач/. No unsupported formal game name or invented rules.
notes.manas-2010:p1595:b001:l030: Оорукка read as the rear/baggage train, with оорукпас meaning not troubled or burdened; the compact wordplay is only partly reproducible.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l006: Шор кайнатуу is bringing severe misfortune, not boiling brine as a weapon. The boiling image retained with misery; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/шор/. Also1602:18 and1604:33.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l008: Сонун marvels is bitter/ironic in this lament, not approval of the coming calamities. Same usage1606:28.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l021: Тобурчак = large fine warhorse; chargers supported by Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/тобурчак/. Буудан denotes swift fine steed; no breed census invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l032: Printed ике read as marriage-contract нике variant in the explicit request that Mazhik marry Aruuke. Raw kept; no change to the requested husband.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l033: Literal horse and bridle retained. No unsupported correction of Атыма to a father reference.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l035: Күмөн is unborn child. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/күмөн/ explains үч айлык калган күмөнүм as a three-month fetus left in the wife; the1969 entry quotes this exact Aruuke line. Rendered three-month child, correcting an initial three-months-until-birth interpretation. Source lacks айлык; gestational reading remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l037: Ninety animals for the birth feast is the implied object of slaughter; source supplies no livestock species, and English does not add one.
notes.manas-2010:p1596:b001:l040: Printed right shoulder retained; not generalized to two broad shoulders.
notes.manas-2010:p1597:b001:l004: Буй кылуу = throw into confusion/distress, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/буй/.
notes.manas-2010:p1597:b001:l009: Мендеден read as ablative менде, mortal/person, verified Yudakhin and1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/менде/. Not silently changed to менден, before me.
notes.manas-2010:p1597:b001:l011: Ürbüs treated as the printed pasture/place name, with Muzdak a named pass in16. Exact modern geographical identification is not established.
notes.manas-2010:p1597:b001:l030: Туяксыз is the no-heir idiom; male heir specified because the preceding lines explicitly contemplate a surviving daughter. The source's patrilineal distinction is preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1597:b001:l038: Printed оюн read contextually as hollowing out the grave, likely an irregular/damaged imperative related to ой-. Qualified; raw not normalized.
notes.manas-2010:p1598:b001:l016: The first-year/Beijing phrase is retained despite its compressed relationship to Suuk-Tör and the dragon. No location silently replaced.
notes.manas-2010:p1598:b001:l020: Six thousand sent and six thousand killed, then six children and I remain: numerical inconsistency and ambiguous inclusion of speaker retained. Seven thousand/seven in21–23 and ten thousand/ten in24–25 likewise not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1598:b001:l029: Printed six months, not years; preserved.30–31 distinguish his learning flight from the speaker learning travel.
notes.manas-2010:p1598:b001:l034: Кезик is a lingering/incurable illness in Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/кезик/. No modern diagnosis assigned. Recovery is conditional in35–36 even though the conventional disease gloss says incurable.
notes.manas-2010:p1598:b001:l041: Казыналык = state/official, Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/казыналык/. State's great marksman replaces an unsupported kept-in-reserve draft; repeated1603:9 and1607:29.
notes.manas-2010:p1599:b001:l008: Аркалуу taken as having supernatural/spiritual support in this epic context; qualified rather than mere breadth of back.
notes.manas-2010:p1599:b003:l015: Оён rendered lordly, an English rank/eminence gloss rather than an opaque transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p1599:b003:l021: Таш сайынган denotes the rank-button insignia; таза in22 means finest/elite rather than bald. Same formula1605:18–19 and1609:35–36.
notes.manas-2010:p1599:b003:l025: Source explicitly says Kögala after naming Almambet in23. Horse/actor inconsistency retained, not repaired to Sarala or Chubak.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l007: Үзүк is the upper felt covering of a yurt; Shuutu's cap comparison preserved. Proper name spelling follows printed Шууту.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l014: Printed Кара Төлөгү treated as the inflected name Kara Tölök, identified here as a diviner.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l015: Күн туу rendered day of need from the danger/support context; this is a contextual reading, not an asserted standalone dictionary meaning.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l028: Seven retained; түмөн is an epic multitude unit, rendered seven vast hosts without fixed numerical conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l034: Кан кылган taken as made bloody in the slaughter context, while36 clearly uses кан as khan. Homography is material;34 remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1600:b001:l039: Жин II = stomach contents; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жин/ quotes the exact кан төк десе жин төккөн formula for excessive obedience. Literal visceral escalation retained, not demons.
notes.manas-2010:p1601:b001:l009: Аты уйкаш is the formula joining names in harmony; not a claim these two names literally rhyme. Also1608:11 Almambet/Chubak.
notes.manas-2010:p1601:b001:l016: Жадашып provisionally understood as mutual weariness, related to жада-, with battle-axes. No silent correction to a different combat verb.
notes.manas-2010:p1601:b001:l032: Saddlecloths upon necks retained literally; cause such as rider death or slipping tack is not inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1602:b001:l021: Шай колдогон describes fortunate supernatural protection:2015 phraseological dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/ШАЙ%20КОЛДОГОН/ and explanatory cross-reference to шаймерден. Sacred support rendered without identifying a particular patron.
notes.manas-2010:p1602:b001:l032: Printed Kögala is now ridden by Kökchö; retained despite other actors/horse pairings nearby.
notes.manas-2010:p1603:b001:l028: Ойкума rendered fearsome sword. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ойкума/ cites these exact two lines and glosses a formidable sword and lengthwise cleaving. Not silently renamed Zhoykuma.
notes.manas-2010:p1603:b001:l029: The text depicts Almambet cutting at Kojozhash, then says the blade's flat breaks a coral stone. The target in27 and action in29 remain as printed; no invented death or recovery added.
notes.manas-2010:p1603:b001:l031: Шуру таш is coral/bead stone and көөкөр a flask. The huge flask-size image retained; the stone's exact protective function is not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1604:b001:l001: Six thousand Chinese and one thousand калдай retained; калдай rendered governors per Yudakhin historical rank https://el-sozduk.kg/калдай/.
notes.manas-2010:p1604:b001:l009: Чоң күрөң rendered a great bay, not silently made into the different named horse Kartküröng.
notes.manas-2010:p1604:b001:l014: Жөө күлүк минген literally riding a swift runner: retained without deciding if this is a named mount or a mythic human runner. Kanjar Kol is the printed personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1604:b001:l019: Forty-two pieces retained exactly, followed by sixty noble officers; no moderation of the violence or totals.
notes.manas-2010:p1605:b001:l005: Parenthesized5–7 is the narrator's metrical reflection on mortality, visibly continuous verse. Retained, including the father's-grave curse; not excluded as editorial prose.
notes.manas-2010:p1605:b001:l028: Кызыталак is the coarse daughter-divorce insult, kept as daughter-divorced; Burut is the source's exonym. Also1606:10, not a neutral characterization by the translator.
notes.manas-2010:p1606:b001:l008: The compressed printed Эркектен кул-күң баш алат places men with male/female slaves and heads. English retains all elements; the gender/syntactic mismatch is not silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1606:b001:l010: Апси = appetite/throat/greed in edition glossary p1834:18; corrupt greed rendered rather than an unexplained transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p1606:b001:l022: Милек is an epic multitude unit, unquantified here in English. Kady ralieva's2014 Manas study lists the unit among immense epic numbers https://arch.kyrlibnet.kg/uploads/ISUKADYRALIEVA2014-27.pdf; Kasymbekova's lexical research lists it with troop-count units https://arabaev.kg/kgubgu/uploads/Касымбекова_Диссертация.pdf. No fixed census or silent change to илек.
notes.manas-2010:p1607:b001:l019: Көркөмдүү is visibly printed: fine appearance retained as the selection criterion. Not silently altered into another martial skill.
notes.manas-2010:p1607:b001:l022: Боз алалуу чуу read as confused/wild uproar; its pale/mottled image belongs to the formula. Бойбой in23 rendered woe cries, not a personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l007: Literal seasoning salt retained in the list of spoils; no invented tactical explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l010: Ала баш appears as a descriptive horse-color phrase in the paired formula; rendered piebald-headed. Possible name resonance with Alabash is not imposed on this line.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l017: Singular he in the printed leader/driver clause is provisionally Ajybay, the nearest named subject; no unsupported assignment to Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l024: Бука сийдик = winding road in2015 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/бук/. Bull-piss image retained alongside winding; not a road literally flooded with urine.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l037: Май кылуу means stain here: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/май/ cites this exact golden-throne/father formula and explains blood-staining. No literal greasing or invented throne destruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1608:b001:l038: The printed statement that Almambet slaughtered his father is retained despite narrative tension. Жай кылып is laying low/killing in the cited Yudakhin formula, not an invented burial rite.
notes.manas-2010:p1609:b001:l010: The object dropped into plain water is supplied as the weather stone from6; exact ritual mechanics remain implicit. The rain spell is also explicitly named in7.
notes.manas-2010:p1609:b001:l024: The source's feminizing insult is retained as whimpering like girls; not neutral translator description of gender.
notes.manas-2010:p1609:b001:l028: A sword clanking in hand precedes a subject shift to Kongurbay dismounting. Exact bearer is grammatically compressed; no actor silently inserted.
